description: This file contains unit tests for various grain placement strategies in an Orleans-based distributed system. It covers testing default placement, random placement, local preference placement, and stateless worker placement, among others.

classes.name: GrainPlacementTests
classes.description: A test class containing various unit tests for grain placement strategies in Orleans.

methods.name: VerifyDefaultPlacement
methods.description: Tests that the default placement returns a ResourceOptimizedPlacement.

methods.name: RandomlyPlacedGrainShouldPlaceActivationsRandomly
methods.description: Verifies that grains are placed on different silos in a pseudo-random manner.

methods.name: PreferLocalPlacedGrainShouldPlaceActivationsLocally_TwoHops
methods.description: Ensures that prefer local placement strategy places grains on the same silo as the caller.

methods.name: CollectActivationIds
methods.description: Collects activation IDs from a grain sample.

methods.name: ActivationCount
methods.description: Counts the number of distinct activations for a grain.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerShouldCreateSpecifiedActivationCount
methods.description: Tests that stateless worker grains create an activation count within specified limits.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerGrainShouldCreateActivationsOnLocalSilo
methods.description: Verifies that stateless worker grains instantiate activations on the local silo.
